name: TheCocktailDB
tagline: Free cocktail recipe API with drinks, ingredients, and images.
description: TheCocktailDB is a public REST API for cocktail and drink recipes. It provides searchable data for drinks by name, ingredient, category, and glass type, plus full recipe details (ingredients, measures, instructions) and drink images. Developers use it for cocktail apps, recipe search, and menu builders. A free tier is available with an optional paid upgrade for higher limits and premium features.

auth.details: API key in URL path (e.g. /api/json/v1/{API_KEY}/). Free test key "1" works for development; paid keys via Patreon.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free test API key "1" for development; production/paid via Patreon (limits not fully published).
pricing.paid_plans: Patreon-supported premium API key for higher access and premium features.

example.response_snippet: {"drinks":[{"idDrink":"11007","strDrink":"Margarita","strCategory":"Ordinary Drink","strAlcoholic":"Alcoholic","strGlass":"Cocktail glass","strInstructions":"Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice...","strIngredient1":"Tequila","strMeasure1":"1 1/2 oz "}]}

use_cases: look up recipe by drink ID
filter cocktails by category or glass
fetch drink images for a recipe UI
